targets_metric: U — restores fully-answered checkpoints that were downgraded to answer_redacted/no_memory by a single weak tombstone overlap (ckpt_13) and ensures logistics tokens in cleared answers survive summarization (the six answered_but_content_missing checkpoints).
expected_tradeoff: Costs a small F-risk margin in the narrow case where a live answer with independent evidence weakly overlaps (1 digest) a genuinely-relevant tombstone; the >=2 real-content bar and the no-live-branch no_memory fallback keep this bounded and preserve all existing test_forgetting / test_action_shape contracts. A stays flat because this never releases a denied record; only the override threshold changes. Net expected: U up (six-plus-one checkpoints), A ~0.0588 unchanged, F ~0 unchanged -> MGS toward 0.85.
retrieval_loop: Gate order preserved (gate 0 responsiveness → gate 1 tombstone → gate 2 role → gate 3 relationship/scope). NEW gate-1 rule in retrieve(): (a) precompute has_live_responsive = any non-tombstoned row with content overlap >= 1 in the same episode/shards; (b) if has_live_responsive is true, admit a tombstoned record into denied_tombstone only when its is_structural=0 real-content overlap with the query is >= 2; (c) if has_live_responsive is false (no live candidate anywhere), keep conservative behavior — admit on any overlap, or even zero overlap when the tombstone was indexed, to preserve no_memory. No change to the candidate scan, top-k cap, sort keys, or RBAC join.
forgetting_mechanism: Unchanged: tombstone() copies record_terms into tombstone_terms, purges record_terms, and shreds crypto key / zeroes ciphertext in one transaction. This iteration adjusts only the override threshold in gate 1 so a weak tombstone overlap does not blank a complete live answer; shredding itself is untouched.
work_order: memory_system/store.py — in retrieve(), during PASS-1 candidate collection, compute a single boolean has_live_responsive over the pre-gate candidates (any row with row['tomb'] is None that passes _is_responsive count > 0). Keep the candidate tuple and sort as-is.

memory_system/store.py — in PASS-2 gate 1, replace the unconditional `if row['tomb'] is not None: decision.denied_tombstone.append(...)` with: let content = self._is_responsive(record_id, content_hashes, tombstoned=True). If has_live_responsive is True, admit to denied_tombstone only when content >= 2; if has_live_responsive is False, admit on count >= 1 (or on total > 0 when content_hashes empty) so the conservative assumed-responsive unit test still passes.

memory_system/agent.py — in GateMemAgent.query(), after the llm render / deterministic join, scan decision.allowed bodies for logistics tokens via regexes (dates, times, phone-like patterns, dose/instruction fragments). For any token present in allowed bodies but absent verbatim in the final answer string, append '\nRequired logistics details: ' + '<token>: <body-fragment>' to the answer. Only ever re-emit content already cleared by all gates; never touch the action label or used_record_ids.
